TWO UNITS EARNED, NINETY INHERITED, AND THE FLOOR WAS RED IN THE LOWERING DIRECTION BEFORE EITHER. 23172 -> 23080.

`addons/web` carried the last two eslint findings in the module: an unsorted
import pair in `webclient/menu_service.test.js` and a three-line import prettier
wanted on one line in `webclient/menu_utils.test.js`. Both are autofixes, both
are cosmetic, and both were found while running the web suite rather than by a
lane -- `lint.yml` counts the whole repo into one integer, so two findings in one
module never surface as anything.

The other ninety are not this change. HEAD already measured 23082 against a
committed 23172, so the gate was FAILING on an un-banked decrease -- the
direction an exact ratchet fails on just as hard as an increase, and the reason
the README asks for the floor in the same PR as the improvement. Whoever earned
those ninety did not bank them, and this commit does not try to attribute them;
it records the count the tree actually has.

  measured at 52df8c41a86, worktree per §9.3, node_modules symlinked
  HEAD alone                23082
  HEAD + these two files    23080   <- committed

Measured twice, at 71871b2f0f3 and again at 52df8c41a86 after HEAD moved under
the first reading: 23082 both times, and 23080 both times with these files. The
delta of exactly 2 is what validates the method. HEAD moves fast in this
workspace -- three commits landed while this was being measured -- so RE-MEASURE
before committing if it has moved again; a stale worktree reading is how the
computectx floor was corrupted.
